summary: A member asks whom a family name would commemorate before voting on a stream.
realLife: O’Donnell identified Irene Dixon Bailey as the applicant’s grandmother when a member asked about Bailey Creek in North Carolina. The federal entry for Bailey Creek in Rutherford County records the June decision under feature 2832564.
inGame: needs: the proposed name, its intended honoree and the applicant’s statement about their relationship.

turns.what: The clerk reads the relationship into the record.
turns.writesBack: The docket names the intended honoree.

turns.what: The member asks the applicant to specify one.
turns.pulledBy: The family history names several people.
